SUN ANGLE INDICATOR
===================

The carry handle has a sun angle indicator. When sunlight hits its surface, a shadow will appear at its bottom.

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js200e_eu_en/sun_angle_indicator.png
   :alt: SolarSaga 200 sun angle indicator with the indicator point and shadow labelled.
   :width: 100%

If the shadow falls on the white inner circle at its bottom, it means that the solar panel is facing directly towards sun and you can get optimal power generation; if not, it is suggested to adjust its angle until it does.

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js200e_eu_en/shadow_guidance.png
   :alt: Correct and incorrect shadow positions for the sun angle indicator.
   :width: 100%

POWER YOUR DEVICE
-----------------

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js200e_eu_en/power_device.png
   :alt: SolarSaga 200 powering a cell phone, power bank and tablet through the multifunctional adapter while connected to a portable power station.
   :width: 100%

.. note::

   This multifunctional solar charging cable is only suitable for charging the Jackery SolarSaga 200 (JS-200E) and should not be used with other solar panels.

.. image:: renderers/web/assets/js200e_eu_en/rubber_plug.png
   :alt: Rubber plug above the multifunctional adapter's USB-C, LED and USB-A interfaces.
   :width: 100%

.. note::

   Insert the rubber plug when USB ports are not in use to prevent dust.
